provenance.paper_title: Continual Harness: Online Adaptation for Self-Improving Foundation Agents

representation_paths.memory_component: persistent textual facts and strategy memory

evidence.paraphrase: Rendered frames, textual game state, actions, and outcomes are summarized into persistent harness memory that the agent consults during later embodied gameplay.

representation_paths.memory_component: persistent executable skills and subagent procedures

evidence.paraphrase: The harness exposes editable skills and subagent procedures whose descriptions and executable bodies are revised from recent multimodal trajectory failures and invoked on later steps.
At fixed online intervals, the Refiner applies create, read, update, and delete edits to the persistent harness prompt, subagents, skills, and memory.
Recent gameplay trajectories are summarized into failure signatures and reusable behavioral guidance before the harness is revised.

Every fixed number of online steps, feedback over recent rendered-frame trajectories revises persistent skill descriptions and procedures in place; the agent immediately retrieves and executes the revised harness on subsequent steps without reset.

derived.hybrid_relation: Textual strategy memory and executable skill procedures are jointly supplied to the online agent.

adjudication_notes: Strict T3 is supported by an uninterrupted online loop in which recent multimodal failures revise persistent skills and procedures that are then used at later steps.
